description: This file defines a template class 'CommandInterface' within the 'WebSockets' namespace, providing an interface for sending commands and handling WebSocket messages, including synchronization mechanisms and logging.

classes.name: CommandInterface
classes.description: A template class providing command sending and message handling functionalities over WebSockets, with thread synchronization and message response management.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command string and waits for a response with a timeout of 5 seconds, returning true if successful.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, updates the last response, and notifies waiting threads.
